name: freqhole-release
description: release coordination (changesets + version sync) for freqhole. not published.

scripts.version: changeset version && make bump-version NEW_VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && npm --prefix client/spume install
scripts.build:libs: npm --prefix lib/haruspex/ts ci && npm --prefix lib/haruspex/ts run build && npm --prefix lib/reliquary/ts ci && npm --prefix lib/reliquary/ts run build
scripts.deploy:spume: npm --prefix client-codegen/freqhole-api-client install && npm run build:libs && npm --prefix client/spume install && npm --prefix client/spume run build && (make -C client/rathole deploy-spume || true)
scripts.deploy:freqhole-net: npm --prefix client-codegen/freqhole-api-client install && npm run build:libs && npm --prefix freqhole.net install && npm --prefix freqhole.net run build
scripts.deploy:storybook: npm --prefix client-codegen/freqhole-api-client install && npm run build:libs && npm --prefix client/spume install && npm --prefix client/spume run build-storybook
